notes.title: Pre-order RoboCop: Rogue City – Unfinished Business
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528916/0fd49b3a9c7692016394486b763e4e2ed30d3ef7.png[/img]

[h1]Pre-order RoboCop: Rogue City – Unfinished Business[/h1]

[b]Suit up. A new threat has taken over the OmniTower, and RoboCop is the only one who can stop it.[/b]

[b]RoboCop: Rogue City – Unfinished Business[/b] is a brand-new, standalone adventure set after the events of the main game and between the RoboCop 2 and 3 films. It brings back the explosive gameplay and atmosphere you loved, while introducing fresh challenges, new allies, and a deadly news enemies.

[previewyoutube=ibbgOXYagzs;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]New faces. New allies. New enemies. One mission: justice.[/h2]

You’ll reunite with key characters like Officer Anne Lewis, Sergeant Warren Reed, and ED-209. But standing in RoboCop’s way are dangerous new opponents like Cassius Graves or his right arm Douglas Cole.

Together, they’ve taken control of the [b]OmniTower[/b], a massive residential complex designed to rebuild Old Detroit. RoboCop must fight his way to the top to save innocent lives, and uncover the truth behind the siege.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3527760/RoboCop_Rogue_City__Unfinished_Business/
[h2]What’s new in Unfinished Business?[/h2]
[list]
[*]A gripping new story set between RoboCop 2 and 3.
[*]New characters and locations.
[*]Powerful new weapons and brutal finish moves.
[*]Speciales missions as Alex Murphy (voiced once again by Peter Weller), ED-209, other...
[/list]
[h2]First press reviews[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b][url=https://www.gamesradar.com/games/fps/robocop-rogue-city-unfinished-business-finally-puts-me-in-control-of-the-series-iconic-ed-209-bot-and-its-as-silly-as-it-is-violent-realism-is-not-a-part-of-robocop-at-all/]GamesRadar+[/url][/b]
[i]"RoboCop: Rogue City – Unfinished Business is more RoboCop but not just more. It's all dialled up. More action. More weapons. More over-the-top. I can't wait to see how high the OmniTower really stretches."[/i]

[*] [b][url=https://www.techradar.com/gaming/robocop-rogue-city-unfinished-business-is-more-of-the-same-but-thats-not-a-bad-thing]TechRadar[/url][/b]
[i]"I walked away eager to see what else RoboCop: Rogue City - Unfinished Business has in store when it arrives for PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X, and Xbox Series S on July 17, 2025."[/i]

[*] [b][url=https://www.mirror.co.uk/gaming/robocop-rogue-city-unfinished-business-35277885]Mirror[/url][/b]
[i]"There’s still a lot to learn about how the story will land and how the Alex Murphy missions will play out. For now, however, it’s still hard to imagine any video game nailing the act of being RoboCop as well as this."[/i]

[*] [b][url=https://metro.co.uk/2025/06/03/robocop-rogue-city-unfinished-business-preview-we-created-something-bigger-expected-23313479/]Metro[/url][/b]
 [i]"This is RoboCop: Rogue City with its pedal to the floor, confined and concentrated into a lean, tightly focused machine."[/i]
[/list]

[h2]Pre-purchase now to receive the exclusive Prime Directives Pack![/h2]

RoboCop: Rogue City – Unfinished Business releases on [b]July 17th[/b]. 
A Mac version is also in development and coming soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45528916/9b4e3314cd213c83f2feb029fb2de4abc851b286.jpg[/img]

notes.title: New Game+ & more!
notes.content:
Greetings citizens!
We're glad to not only announce, but also launch a new major update for RoboCop: Rogue City!


[h1]New Game Plus is here.[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40847542/fb203c60951a5a3527c733d9727c2dcf7cde0cc9.jpg[/img]

Re-live the journey with all of your previously unlocked skills and Auto-9 upgrades, for the full "invincible robotic law enforcement officer" experience.

To unlock the mode, just finish the game after the update is applied — this can be done by reloading a save made just before completing the game. Once done, a new save file will be created, and loading it will grant you access to NG+!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40847542/614d6b5294f3e3f7c0ce0e150a1d60709c13a321.png[/img]

[b]Alongside, a new Golden Auto-9 skin will be unlocked as soon as you beat the game. [/b]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]But wait, there's more![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40847542/6cc631076ab282360616e62de3a894685aeac356.jpg[/img]

Coming along NG+ is a new difficulty level, making enemies deadlier.
If you're up for a challenge, time to try the "There Will be Trouble" difficulty!

[hr][/hr]
[h2]Changelog:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a New Game Plus mode
[*] Added a new difficulty: "There Will be Trouble"
[*] Added a new unlockable Golden Auto-9 skin, available once NG+ is available
[*] Added more Auto-9 Chips and Boards
[*] Fixed the shooting mode not properly resetting when exiting interiors
[*] Fixed RoboCop's right hand disappearing when grabbing a human enemy while [i]unaliving[/i] them
[*] Fixed the Stolen Vehicle investigation being skipped if Ben immediately opened the locker
[/list]

[h3]Follow our socials for more:[/h3]

notes.title: Steam's 2023 sleeper hit FPS game gets highly requested update
notes.content:
RoboCop Rogue City stands as one of 2023's greatest Steam shooters, with a solid 9/10 on Valve's platform and thousands of stellar reviews. If you're a longtime fan of the iconic part man, part machine cop, or even a casual FPS enjoyer, Teyon's single-player game is definitely one you can't miss. Rogue City is about to get even bigger too, as the developer reveals the coming addition of a highly requested New Game Plus mode.
